name: Weapon Magazine
description: Every gun holds {{multiplier}} times as many rounds before reloading.
author: KSFA

settings.label: Magazine multiplier
settings.help: Whole numbers only - these are whole-number columns in the game. 1 leaves it at stock. Capped at x10, well inside a defensible multiple of the highest magazine size the stock game itself ever uses.

patches.sql: UPDATE master_part SET capacity = capacity * {{multiplier}} WHERE type = 'PTTP_ARM' AND capacity > 0;
